_comment: Descriptive portal content from the 'Simba Data Lake Admin Portal Concept' deck. Edit wording here; no code change needed. Statuses describe project state and must be kept accurate by the team.
title: Simba Data Lake
subtitle: Admin Portal

about.heading: What is the Data Lake?
about.body: The Simba Data Lake provides a trusted, governed, and scalable data foundation for Simba's digital banking analytics and migration. It brings together data from across UBA into a unified, secure lakehouse on Databricks, enabling better insights, faster innovation and data-driven decision making.
about.tagline: From Data to a Brighter Africa
about.quote: Harnessing the power of data to create inclusive growth across Africa.

architecture.summary: End-to-end flow from source systems to analytics and AI, built on Databricks (on AWS).

items.name: RedApp
items.detail: PostgreSQL — approved TEST extract to S3

layers.name: Bronze
layers.body: Raw data as it comes from source systems. Minimal transformations, kept in original format.

layers.name: Silver
layers.body: Cleansed, deduplicated and standardized data, conformed to common data models and business rules.

layers.name: Gold
layers.body: Business-ready, analytics-optimized data. Aggregated, enriched and modeled for downstream consumption.

principles.name: Unity Catalog
principles.detail: Central catalog for tables, schemas, permissions and lineage.

principles.name: Role-based access control
principles.detail: Access granted to groups, not individuals, wherever possible.

principles.name: Data masking
principles.detail: Sensitive columns masked or excluded in shared views.

principles.name: Audit trail
principles.detail: Access and changes recorded in Databricks audit logs.

principles.name: Encryption
principles.detail: Encryption at rest (S3 / KMS) and in transit (TLS).

principles.name: Least privilege
principles.detail: Each identity receives only the permissions it needs.

principles.name: Environment separation
principles.detail: Separate Dev, UAT and Prod environments.

request_process: Choose the request type below and submit it through the UBA service portal.
The data team validates the business need and the dataset owner approves.
Access is granted to the appropriate Unity Catalog group (never directly to a person where avoidable).
You are notified, and the grant becomes visible on the Security & Governance page.

faq.a: The portal only shows values it has read from Databricks. If a query is not permitted or a table does not exist yet, the value is shown as unavailable rather than estimated.

faq.q: How fresh is the data on this page?
faq.a: Kafka activity and job runs refresh every few seconds to a minute; table inventory, lineage and grants refresh every few minutes. The status indicator in the header shows when each was last checked.

faq.q: Why is a Kafka topic missing?
faq.a: Only topics that have delivered at least one event to the Bronze table are listed. A topic with no events in its retention window will not appear.

faq.q: Can I see real customer data here?
faq.a: No. Sample previews are limited to approved, masked tables or views, and only a handful of rows are shown.
